Use case: stylized-concept. National cultural heritage travel illustration in the visual style of Day of the Tentacle adventure-game backgrounds with strongly exaggerated wonky angular architecture, crooked perspective and thick dark plum ink contours, combined with sculpted cel-shaded 3D volume, soft cast shadows, ambient occlusion and visible layered depth. NOT a realistic photo. Clear foreground/middle/background separation for parallax shader presentation, atmospheric distant scenery, bold silhouettes and rich organized details. Use real recognizable landmarks from the specified country only, regionally accurate natural animals in separate appropriate habitats. No invented landmark combinations presented as a literal place: this is explicitly a national travel montage. Natural animals without clothes, anthropomorphism or silly expressions. No octopuses, tentacles, fantasy creatures, silly characters or people. No words, lettering, flags, logos, watermarks or national emblems. STRICT EVERYWHERE even tiny skyline: no mosque, minaret, Islamic religious architecture, Islamic symbols, religious crescents, Islamic inscriptions or calligraphy. Civilian background houses only. Authentic Christian churches/cathedrals, Buddhist/Hindu temples, synagogues and ancient sacred monuments ARE allowed and encouraged when significant; do not exclude permitted landmarks merely because religious. Represent listed authentic regional sites without inventing extra religious buildings. Final composition is a broad representative regional selection, never all districts or exhaustive heritage. Keep every primary landmark roof and all animal silhouettes fully inside frame, with margins. Country: Botswana. Palette from supplied collection: #81A9F0 #9ED3F4 #AEDED2 #C0C4EC, supported by muted natural stone, wood and vegetation colors with purple shadows. Show these authentic landmarks in distinct regional clusters: Tsodilo rock art (Northwest); Okavango delta (Northwest); Makgadikgadi salt pans (Central); Kubu Island baobabs (Central); Moremi wetlands (Northwest); Tuli sandstone landscape (Central). Natural animals in appropriate separate habitats: African elephant, African wild dog, zebra. Local plants: baobab, mopane. Small optional authentic craft/food detail: woven baskets, dugout mokoro. Cover panorama3:1 final1500x500. Clear broad region clusters from left to right, animal foreground near lower-right and plants lower-left; ample upper breathing room, mountains and sky far behind.
CRITICAL visual priority: THICK dark plum cartoon contours and exaggerated angular rocks, chunky sculpted3D pastel cel-shading, no realistic textures. Rich layered Botswana landscape montage in very wide3:1 format, Tsodilo rock art, delta channels, salt pans and baobab island, Tuli stone forms. Natural elephant lower-right with entire silhouette within generous margins; African wild dog and zebra separated in savanna habitat. Empty mokoro and woven basket lower-left. No people or buildings.
